faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR NIO is 20 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Project Associate - I post is a Masters degree in Geoinformatics. Ensure you meet this criterion before proceeding with the application.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - I position will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - I post in the CSIR NIO Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) is located in Goa, India.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contractual job. The Project Associate - I position is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SSP003864/3309-26.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification mentions the job is in Goa. While specific state restrictions aren't detailed, candidates from all eligible backgrounds are encouraged to apply if they meet the qualifications and can work in Goa.
